sloka: दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषितश्चाहं रावणेन दुरात्मना ।पृष्टश्च लङ्कागमनं राक्षसानां च तं वधम् ।। ५.५८.१३० ।।।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣitaścāhaṁ rāvaṇena durātmanā ।pṛṣṭaśca laṅkāgamanaṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca taṁ vadham ।। 5.58.130 ।।।।

translations.english: "The wickedminded Ravana, then enquired me why I came to Lanka and why I killed the demons.
